I replied in #strategic-random, in Ruth's thread, and I've not posted any brief yet.

I told Ruth two things:
- I can't set up a recurring 07:45 post with the tools I have, and a Hermes cron job wouldn't post into Slack. I didn't test this against a scheduler, so that's my read of the tools, not a confirmed limit.
- A brief that pulls from #inc-vtg-hartford or #strategic-pod would show content to people in this channel who can't see those channels now. Finance figures from #strategic-pod also need approval from Anselm or June before they go anywhere else.

I suggested either a brief limited to what this channel's members can already see, or a separate incident-room brief, and asked which she wants.
